title: Recording now available for the April 24, 2026 CFDE Public Webinar Series!
summary: Unable to join today's CFDE webinar? The recording is now live.
bodyHtml:
‼️ Unable to join today's CFDE Public Webinar Series?

🎙️ UniProt presented recent work and collaborations advancing AI-driven biomedical discovery.

Topics included:
🧬 A knowledge graph for data integration and knowledge discovery
🧪 An introduction to the Protein Knowledge Network (ProKN) and key use cases
🔗 Integration of ProKN and CFDE within the NSF Proto-OKN initiative

💻 The recording is now live: https://youtu.be/DG96cbZ1QI8
